rules.name: Company agents
rules.note: The company's EndpointGuard and endpoint-manager (MDM) agents ask the proxy for their servers by bare names the VPN's exit can't resolve. Keep them on Cisco / the office network.

rules.name: Claude
rules.note: Through Cisco when it is connected; without Cisco, Claude refuses Iranian IPs, so it goes through the VPN.

rules.name: Iranian sites
rules.note: Banks, payment gateways and government sites often refuse foreign IPs, and Iranian sites are faster without the VPN. 'ir' means every .ir domain.

rules.name: YouTube
rules.note: Everything not listed goes through the VPN anyway; this rule only documents it.
